about: A campaign mails the people a post-login activity is due for a reminder to sign in, where the activity then asks them to do it. A scheduler job reads each running campaign's people a slice at a time, about every {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, and mails only the people the activity is due for — never twice within the reminder interval, and never more than the campaign's maximum. The mail's one link opens the sign-in page; it carries no credential.
noMail: No mail transport is configured in this realm, so a running campaign mails nobody. Set one up on Server configuration → Mail.
noActivity: No post-login profile in this realm has an activity switched on, so nobody is due one and a campaign would mail nobody. Turn one on in Directory → Policies.
reportLink: Who was mailed, and where each person stands: the postLoginProgress report
none: No campaign has been started in this realm.
numbers: every {interval, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, at most {max} per person, {perRun} people a run
done: {passes, plural, one {# pass} other {# passes}}, {read} read, {mailed} mailed, {refused} refused
groupHint: A group's name or DN, to mail only its members; empty for everybody in the realm.
startNote: Mailing starts at the job's next run. A person who has done the activity, or whom the realm cannot ask, is not mailed.
readOnly: Starting, pausing and ending a campaign needs Admin Write.
